why_not_now: 39 of the 47 how-tos are experiment arms or adjacent to them, with reads landing 2026-09-21 and 2026-09-22. Merging before the reads destroys them. This map exists so 09-21 is a one-step job.
mechanism: GitHub Pages cannot issue a 301. Each folded page KEEPS its URL and gets <link rel="canonical"> to its target, with its unique material moved into the target as a section. Nothing is deleted, so no URL 404s and no inbound link breaks.
requires: A new pre-registration before execution, per the CEO's order.
